Re-transcribed and imported recordings keep their timing.

- **Transcript times are right again.** A meeting the phone re-transcribed, filled in after a gap, or imported from a file used to come back with every line at 0:00, and highlights generated from it on the desktop all landed at 00:00:00 (#576). Lines now carry their real start and end times.
- Recordings already affected can be fixed by re-transcribing them once.
